name: Hiratsuka Rai
source:
"...To shout in front of an actor... What do you think?"

A popular theatre actor. He has a big ego, but his talents are highly recognized.

Since the theatre is nearby, he visits the cafe several times a week.

He is Akutagawa's childhood friend, and they have a "dog-monkey" relationship.

[Translated from [url=https://karakuren.wixsite.com/irohanihoheto/%E4%BA%BA%E7%89%A9-1]offiical website[/url]]
